_about: Restores the source's scene rhythm in the reading edition. The digital source marks NO scene breaks typographically (every paragraph is the same style); it heads some scenes with terse time/place lines and hard-cuts the rest. 'datelines' lists those scene-header lines verbatim (rendered centered, distinct from body text). 'breaks' lists the opening words of paragraphs that begin a new scene at a hard cut with no dateline (a centered divider is inserted before them). Editorial typographic aids only: no word of the text is added, dropped, or changed.
